## UI Observation — Ticker Search Requires Redundant Navigation Step

Observed on the newssite at :8082. The ticker search/autocomplete has two friction points where the user's intent is already clear but a second action is required:

### Issue 1 — Clicking an autocomplete suggestion doesn't navigate
When a user clicks a ticker in the autocomplete dropdown, the ticker is placed in the search input box but the user must then click the "Go" arrow button to navigate to the ticker page. The click itself is unambiguous intent — clicking a suggestion should immediately navigate to `/ticker/{TICKER}`.

### Issue 2 — Arrow key + Enter doesn't navigate
